abstract: Cross-Encoder Re-ranking for Scientific Literature (1). We study hybrid retrieval for research copilots. Retrieval quality determines answer faithfulness. Our corpus contains one million arXiv abstracts encoded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Dense retrieval and BM25 are fused via reciprocal rank fusion with k=60, then re-ranked with bge-reranker. Experiments show hybrid search improves recall at 50 and mean reciprocal rank compared to dense alone. Latency remains bounded on CPU with batch 32.
